text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Primary S3, September to November, a 2-hour battery at a 20% share, week from 6 October 2025. Series, battery, and block follow a fixed rule (the first of each), not the best result. The simulated battery follows the estimator's own dispatch. The last two panels repeat steps 3 and 4 for the first real public battery of rung 3, in the same series, block, week, and share. Step 4: dot, posterior median; thick bar, 50% interval; thin line, 90% interval; orange tick, the truth. The fitted schedule before the smooth state-of-charge gate is drawn, so its edges are sharper than the estimator's.'
